scenes.title: Thirty-Five Minutes
scenes.summary: Mohan panics over double-booking Room 7 while Pratap unlocks the narrow staircase to the third-floor attic study.

scenes.title: The Sunny Attic
scenes.summary: Up in the timber-beamed attic room, Kavya, Pratap, and Diya inspect the cosy space and tally the missing lamp, mirror, and rug.

scenes.title: Left at the Landing
scenes.summary: Kavya, Diya, and Mohan finish making the attic bed and switch on the warm brass lamp right as the eight o'clock guest rings the gate bell.

scenes.title: In from the Rain
scenes.summary: Quiet architect Kabir steps in soaked from the rain, and Diya and Kavya warm him with a dry towel and hot soup before explaining the room mix-up.

scenes.title: Half Price and Quiet Beams
scenes.summary: Shown the warm timber-beamed attic room at half price, acoustic-minded Kabir marvels at the silence and happily accepts the silver key.

scenes.title: A Five-Star Sigh of Relief
scenes.summary: Downstairs Mohan celebrates the peaceful solution until Kavya spots Kabir's open leather notebook with acoustic scores on the counter—and a pipe clanks.

scenes.title: Returning the Notebook
scenes.summary: Kavya returns Kabir's leather notebook to the attic room, where both of them hear the corner pipe knock and feel the radiator turning cool.

scenes.title: Ice-Cold Pipes
scenes.summary: Climbing up from the cellar, Pratap breaks bad news: the brass pressure valve on the boiler cracked, threatening ice-cold morning showers.
